tour.name: Portugal Highlights 10-Day Private Tour: Lisbon, Sintra, Évora, the Algarve, Óbidos, Coimbra, Porto & the Douro
tour.subtitle: Ten days across Portugal with private guides and a vehicle: Lisbon and Sintra, Évora and the Alentejo, the cliffs and caves of the Algarve, Óbidos, Nazaré and Coimbra, Porto and its port cellars, and the vineyards of the Douro Valley.

tour.overview:
Portugal is compact enough to see in depth in ten days. This private tour travels by road from Lisbon south to the Algarve and back north to Porto and the Douro, with private guides for each region and a driver throughout.

You see the monuments of the Age of Discovery, Sintra's palaces, the Roman and medieval Alentejo, the golden cliffs of the south, the heartland of Óbidos, Nazaré and Coimbra, and the wines and city of Porto, with nine nights in well-located hotels.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 10 days, 9 nights
• Start: Lisbon airport or your hotel
• End: Porto airport or your hotel
• Type: private tour with licensed guides, private vehicle and driver; 9 nights with breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy to moderate

WHAT YOU SEE
• Lisbon and Sintra.
• Évora.
• The Algarve.
• Óbidos, Nazaré and Coimbra.
• Porto and the Douro Valley.

WHY THIS WORKS
Travelling by private vehicle lets you link regions with stops on the way, without changing trains or carrying luggage.

WHO IT SUITS
First-time visitors, couples, families and small groups.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
Add Madeira or the Azores with a short flight.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Portugal is in the Schengen area. Summer is hot in the south and inland; spring and autumn are ideal.

private: Licensed private guides for all guided days
9 nights with breakfast in 4-star or boutique hotels (3 in Lisbon, 2 in the Algarve, 1 in Coimbra or Óbidos, 3 in Porto)
Entrance tickets, boat trips and tastings in the programme

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Do we change vehicles?
faq.answer: No. One private driver accompanies you throughout, with local guides in each region.

faq.question: Can the route be reversed?
faq.answer: Yes, starting in Porto and ending in Lisbon.

faq.question: What kind of hotels are used?
faq.answer: Comfortable 4-star or boutique hotels, including a pousada or quinta where possible.

faq.question: Can we add Madeira or the Azores?
Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. We book family rooms and adapt the pace.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely. Tell us your needs and we will adapt the walking.

faq.question: Are meals included?
faq.answer: Breakfast daily and lunch in the Douro; your guides suggest restaurants.

faq.question: Do we need a visa?
faq.answer: Portugal is in the Schengen area; check the rules for your nationality.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Comfortable shoes with grip, layers, swimwear and sun protection.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: March to June and September to October.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not obligatory in Portugal, but rounding up or leaving 5 to 10 percent for a guide or driver you were happy with is appreciated.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour starts. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
